@@U02813@@
If I had tongues of fire they would not serve! When Beauty, forever the poet's inspiration, comes, the singer is driven beyond himself, and he who possesses her has known too much of joy.

@@U02815@@
Do I still have eyes? Or is it deep in my soul I see Beauty’s wellspring in full stream? My quest of terror has brought me a blissful reward. How without meaning, how closed the world was to me! But my priesthood has made it desirable, well founded, enduring! May the breath of life desert me if I resign myself to living without you. The fair form that bewitched me long ago in a magic reflection was a mere mocking counterfeit of this Beauty. I pledge to you herewith, as tribute due, the sum of my strength, the quintessence of passion, affection, love, adoration, madness!

@@U02817@@
(From the prompter’ box.)

@@U02818@@
Control yourself! Remember, you're acting!

@@U02820@@
Tall, well built, only the head too small.

@@U02822@@
Look at her feet. How coarse they are.
translation:
@@U02813@@
如果我有火舌，他们就不会服务！当美丽永远是诗人的灵感来源时，歌手就会超越自己，而拥有她的人就会享受到太多的快乐。

@@U02815@@
我还有眼睛吗？还是我的灵魂深处看到了美丽的源泉在源源不断地流淌？我对恐怖的追求给我带来了幸福的回报。世界对我来说是多么没有意义啊！但我的神职生涯使它变得令人向往、有根据、持久！如果我屈从于没有你的生活，愿生命的呼吸抛弃我。很久以前，在神奇的倒影中令我着迷的美丽形象只不过是对这位美丽的嘲讽赝品。我在此向你保证，我的力量之和，激情、感情、爱、崇拜和疯狂的精髓，作为应有的敬意！

@@U02817@@
（来自提示框。）

@@U02818@@
控制住自己！记住，你是在演戏！

@@U02820@@
身材高大，身材匀称，只是头太小了。

@@U02822@@
看看她的脚。它们是多么粗糙啊。
